item.title: Playing with Elixir is just FUN
item.description:
I’ve been using Elixir for a few weeks now, sometimes forcing it to play nice with Mongodb/Meteor , which it doesn’t really want to do. Sometimes with Posgres (which it loves). Sometimes just plain ole’ Elixir with no persistance.

It is realllllly fun!

item.title: 2017 nerd goals
item.description: 2017 nerd goals Personal Nerd Goals publish - rejuvenate a history of developer advocacy learn elixir - build a couple of projects from a couple of angles learn machine learning basics This year I’m focusing on getting back to my roots in developer advocacy.
